target.title: fix(agents): keep read warning args previews UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `read` tool validation warning preview must be both UTF-16 safe and visibly truncated when raw string args exceed the 200-code-unit warning budget. The earlier safe-slice follow-up still measured truncation with `for...of`, which counts Unicode code points. For `"😀".repeat(101)`, the safe slice shortened 202 UTF-16 code units to 200, but the code-point count stayed below the limit and omitted the ellipsis.

## Why This Change Was Made

The warning now detects truncation with JavaScript string `.length`, matching the UTF-16 code-unit contract used by `truncateUtf16Safe`. The existing safe slice and console sanitization remain unchanged. A regression test exercises the production `handleToolExecutionStart` path with 101 astral characters and verifies 100 complete emoji plus `…`, with no lone surrogate.

## User Impact

Read-tool validation warnings remain well-formed at emoji/astral boundaries and consistently show when oversized arguments were truncated.

## Evidence

- Exact tested head: `01b9ba8c32c9dfe29eb52423e817aaf578dfbb5a`.
- Current-head production-handler proof: a one-off Vitest probe invoked the real `handleToolExecutionStart` read-tool warning path with `args: String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600).repeat(101)` and printed:

```json
{
  "handler": "handleToolExecutionStart",
  "toolName": "read",
  "argsExpression": "String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600).repeat(101)",
  "argsPreviewUtf16Length": 201,
  "previewCodePointCount": 101,
  "emojiCountBeforeEllipsis": 100,
  "endsWithEllipsis": true,
  "lastCodePointHex": "2026",
  "hasLoneSurrogate": false,
  "consoleMessageIncludesPreview": true
}
```

- Current-head focused regression proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts -t "marks astral-only read warning args previews as truncated|keeps read warning args previews on UTF-16 boundaries"` passed (`2 passed`, `4 passed | 242 skipped`, 19.31s wall time). The tests call production `handleToolExecutionStart` and assert the preview is exactly 100 complete emoji plus `…`, with no lone high or low surrogate.
- Current-head broader read-warning proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.tools.test.ts -t "read warning|astral|surrogate|UTF-16"` passed (`2 passed`, `6 passed | 240 skipped`, 23.28s wall time).
- `git diff --check`: pass.
- Before fix: the new astral-only regression failed on the earlier implementation because it received 100 emoji without `…`.
- Exact-commit autoreview on the prior implementation pass remains clean: commit `da74bd8b81a4f0722e929e2b45c77820f40a9590`, model `gpt-5.5` high reasoning, result `patch is correct`, findings none. The current-head proof above covers the final shared-sanitizer follow-up at `01b9ba8c32c9dfe29eb52423e817aaf578dfbb5a`.
